title: One-step recursion for the survival probability
hypotheses_covered: s is a state (multigraph with a distinguished cut)
replaced:
The unfolding equation: the survival probability for $\text{steps}+1$ contractions at $s$
is the average over all edge occurrences of $s$ of the survival probability for
$\text{steps}$ contractions at the contracted state, with crossing occurrences
contributing $0$.
